picks.editorial_note: NASA's formal entry into the Genesis Mission — a whole-of-government initiative launched by executive order with 15+ federal agencies — signals the most significant coordinated push yet to embed AI across the U.S. federal scientific enterprise.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's role leading 13 Genesis Mission projects and partnering on 30 more makes it the single largest institutional beneficiary of the DOE initiative disclosed this week, underscoring the scale of federal investment in AI-for-science infrastructure.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: RIKEN's AGIS program to build generative AI foundation models purpose-built for scientific research represents a distinct international bet on AI-native science infrastructure, outside the U.S. Genesis Mission framework.
picks.title: TRIP Headquarters Advanced General Intelligence for Science Program (AGIS)

picks.editorial_note: CuspAI's £330 million raise at a £2 billion valuation, with an Imperial College scientist as Chief Scientific Officer, is one of the largest funding events of the week for AI-driven materials discovery, blending academic expertise with serious private capital.
picks.title: Imperial expert leads science at £2 billion AI materials company CuspAI

picks.editorial_note: DARPA and the U.S. Air Force flying an AI-controlled F-16 marks a concrete technical milestone toward autonomous air combat, with implications reaching well beyond the lab into defense policy and military strategy.
picks.title: DARPA and U.S. Air Force fly AI-controlled F-16, paving the way for autonomous air combat

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's selection to lead six Genesis Mission projects and partner on 17 others shows the depth of national-lab involvement in the initiative, spanning AI, high-performance computing, and quantum research.
picks.title: Sandia selected to lead six Genesis Mission projects, partner on 17 others

picks.editorial_note: USC's national leadership role developing AI turbulence-prediction models has direct cross-sector applications in energy and transportation, illustrating how the Genesis Mission is translating into concrete scientific tools.
picks.title: USC leads national AI research project to accelerate scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $83 million investment in AI-ready data infrastructure is a major, independent funding commitment that strengthens the research backbone supporting AI-driven science across many institutions at once.
picks.title: NSF announces $83M investment in integrated data systems and services to advance AI-driven science and strengthen U.S. research infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's Genesis Mission awards, including AI/ML reconstruction work for particle physics, demonstrate how the initiative is accelerating fundamental science at premier physics facilities.
picks.title: U.S. Department of Energy invests in Fermilab projects to accelerate AI-enabled scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: The Frank Whittle Summit at Cambridge convened UK government, industry, and research leaders to chart an AI-driven industrial strategy for aerospace, energy, and defence, reflecting a significant national policy and partnership push outside the U.S.
picks.title: Landmark summit at Cambridge's new Whittle Laboratory aims to reignite Britain's industrial engine in aerospace, energy and defence
